''See also: [[Champion Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Champions]] are legendary, superhuman warriors associated with the [[Champion’s Guild|Champion's Guild]], which is one of the oldest [[Imperial Guilds]]. Historically, these fighters have played a decisive role in the unification of [[The Empire|the Empire]], and their presence on a battlefield often guarantees victory. They are distinguished from [[Soulbound]] individuals by a secret, intensive process of alchemical treatments and rigorous training that begins in childhood. This regimen focuses on combat, mental conditioning to instill a sense of invincibility, and physical enhancement. As a result, [[Champions]] possess extreme strength, speed, and mental attributes, making them nearly impossible to defeat in combat. They are also noted for having a natural resistance to poisons and possessing a physical density that makes them much heavier than they appear. In the modern era, [[Champions]] often earn their living through exhibition matches or duels to demonstrate an employer's power. While the [[Guild]] was once a major political force, it has recently faced dissolution, leaving only individual [[Champions]] remaining. [[The Guild]]'s symbol is the [[Golden Crown]]. Despite their immense power, some [[Champions]] maintain a commitment to neutrality.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A true member of the [[Champion’s Guild|Champion's Guild]] is defined as being much more than a mere [[Soulbound]]. These individuals possess the ability to meditate in order to hone their various skills. While a Champion is expected to never fail even when in disgrace, they can still be unnerved by a gaze consisting of solid blue-white eyes. In certain circumstances, such a warrior might be capable of keeping men away from [[Calder]].}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A [[Champion]] can be unnerved by a gaze like solid blue-white eyes.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Champion]] might be able to keep men off [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A true [[Champion]] of the [[Champion’s Guild]] is more than just a [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c17">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Champions]] can meditate to hone their skills.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A Champion is a specialized individual who may serve as a mercenary for hire. Known by the name [[Twelve]], this warrior operates while blindfolded and utilizes a [[sword]] in combat. These entities possess augmentations that grant resistance to most poisons, though they are distinct from [[Calder]], who possesses a Champion of his own. Potential candidates must meet specific requirements concerning their training and the nature of their [[Soulbound]], as samples of [[Champions]] remain available.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A [[Champion]] can be a mercenary for hire.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champion]] is blindfolded and uses a [[sword]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champion]]'s name is [[Twelve]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Champion augmentation]] provides resistance to most poisons.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] has a [[Champion]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Champions]] have requirements regarding training and the nature of their [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A Champion is a combatant whose power manifests as an intensity comparable to two bonfires held just out of reach. During a specific event, one such Champion appeared at the end of a row of boxes, wearing both a blindfold and the [[Golden Crown of the Champions]]. This individual was present during a fight and exhibited signs of physical stress, such as slight sweating. The nature of their power is tied to [[Intent]], which remains more stable when it is donated voluntarily rather than being taken from corpses or seized involuntarily. The immense capability of these figures is significant enough that [[Meia]] [[dreams]] of one day rivaling a Champion.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Champions]] possess [[Intent]] that is preserved better when donated voluntarily than when taken from corpses or involuntarily.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Champion]] stood at the end of the row of boxes wearing a blindfold and the [[Golden Crown of the Champions]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Champion]] is present and began to sweat slightly.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Champion]] is a combatant who was present at the fight.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The powers of the two [[Champions]] are like two bonfires just out of arm's reach.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Meia]] [[dreams]] of rivaling a [[Champion]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
